skill_name: Construct a logical argument for why artificial intelligence is beneficial to humanity.
workflow: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to dramatically improve the lives of people around the world. AI can assist with everyday tasks, from scheduling appointments to providing medical advice, and it can automate jobs that are repetitive, time consuming, and dangerous. AI can aid in decision making, helping to ensure that the best possible choices are made quickly and accurately. AI can help to inform policy decisions and development projects so that resources can be used more effective
